learning_outcomes: Understand and explain deep learning, including motivation, problem formulation, algorithms, and science behind deep learning.
Analyze and evaluate the design and implementation of deep neural networks.
Choose and apply appropriate methods and tools to solve problems using deep neural networks.
Design and construct deep learning systems using appropriate methods.
Think critically about using deep learning models for different tasks and their potential societal impact.
Communicate findings (both positive and negative results) through presentations and project reports.
topics: AI vs. ML vs. NN (artificial intelligence vs. machine learning vs. neural networks)
Learning from data, training and inference with neural networks
Convolutional operation, edge detection, feature extraction, channels, padding, stride, pooling layers
Text data, bag of words, embeddings, skip-gram models
Learnable weights, scaling: scaled dot product self-attention
Positional embedding, linear layer, skip connections, layer normalization

skills.evidence: The class will provide an overview of the main building blocks of deep learning systems, as well as deeper dives into the theory and practice of deep learning.
Main Classes of Deep Learning Models: Convolutional Neural Networks – image data
Main Classes of Deep Learning Models: Sequence Models (RNNs) – text data
Main Classes of Deep Learning Models: Transformer Architecture
You will have a chance to: design a deep learning model, implement the model in PyTorch, train and evaluate the model.
Topics include gradient descent and backpropagation.
Topics include gradient descent and backpropagation.
Topics include logistic regression, binary cross-entropy.
Advanced and Related Topics include Autoencoders.
Advanced and Related Topics include Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs).
